integrity: A finite exact checker supplements a symbolic proof using an explicit convex involution mixture and a supporting-hyperplane inequality; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact projection of a distinguished family of fractional symmetric doubly stochastic vertices, not a global Hausdorff distance; non-Frobenius metrics and other fractional vertices are not covered. Historical priority provisional.
title: Parity-sensitive Frobenius projection of repeated triangular fractional matchings
